title: Programmable fill with the owner's psc-line-2pt.pas tile
description: A 40 x 40 mm square sewn as programmable fill with an owner-made Programmable Stitch Creator tile (psc-line-2pt.pas) imported by pattern.import: needle points where the 45-degree rows cross the tile's lines, the tile on the page axes from the region's top-left corner.
